verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch filings, bulk renewals, or bulk data export, are a fair capability to ask of an IP-office operations platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only individual filing procedures (trademark, patent, design, e-Soleau) and database search. Nothing shows acting on many items at once. The probe shows only that the open-data portal requires a token, which says nothing about bulk capability.
